title: Prove exact 2r-1 completion for rank-one residual forms (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof with exact finite corroboration. Every injective binary symplectic partial map with displacement rank r and residual-form rank one has exact minimum transvection length 2r-1. The new cases have r at least three. This settles the rank-one slice of Krzysztof Wojt / PR5097's higher-rank opening; its lower bound, zero-form construction and known rank-two case are credited inputs.

```text
rank(b)=1, dim D=r
  choose a with b(a,a)=1
  T_a h has zero residual form and displacement rank r-1
  one pivot + 2(r-1) remaining turns = 2r-1
```

All axes stay in the original ambient space. Required fixed spectators are included in the prescribed partial map. The package adds a self-contained proof, a bounded constructor and a separate dense-coordinate word checker. No native paid-rank gain or new kappa is claimed.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Krzysztof Wojt / krzysztofwojt / #5097, Nick Petalas / #5085, Brian / JoyboyBrian / #5051, David Ganz / Dugongue / #4841, Cao Yifan / intqwq, Cinna Davis, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and the retained native/compiler lineage. Classical symplectic transvections, residual forms and binary elimination retain their credit. No predecessor scientific executable or receipt is imported, replayed or audited.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19363481). Canonical base is 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. TASK.json records the changed formal-interface-lemma scope and SOURCES.json pins the cited problem statements as provenance.

## Evidence

- Before: #5097 gives the interval [2r-1,2r] for this higher-rank slice. After: the new all-rank pivot proves attainment of 2r-1; the first new r=3 case needs exactly five turns.
- Both final warning-strict modes print PASS_RANK_ONE_RESIDUAL_COMPLETION and identical generated hash-bound receipts. Complete checks cover 1,235 distinct rank-one forms at r=3,4,5, including all 242 zero-diagonal cases; 52 larger/conjugated fixtures through r=12; every emitted full matrix, symplectic pairing and prescribed fixed spectator; and full displacement rank exactly 2r-1. All 182 one-turn omissions and 14 malformed/out-of-scope/system controls reject.
- Direct final normal and optimized checks took 0.857 and 0.822 seconds locally, below each registered 120-second timeout. Registered replay passes both modes. CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, standard library only.
- Seven-file committed-byte comparison and declared source-history preflight pass at 625a248021706eb91d76e89198cd31a4040a68f8. Official committed export integrity and declared-input coverage pass. Both modes also pass from the read-only Git-free export with an empty executable search path; every exported byte and mode remains unchanged.
- Warning-strict source compilation and AST function-bound checks pass. The constructor's longest function is 29 lines; the checker's is 31. Ruff is unavailable locally. Python allocation is bounded by the API cap and documented as a managed-runtime deviation.

From the worktree root, using the actual local interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/rank-one-residual-completion/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/rank-one-residual-completion/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank-one-residual-completion
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rank-one-residual-completion --check-source-history
```

Other hosts may substitute CPython 3.12. Standalone verification needs no Git or external runtime inputs. The package runner also prints PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal result rests on the written proof. Finite enumeration covers forms and explicit realizations, not every partial map. The executable API is capped at 16 qubits; the theorem has no dimension cap. Other residual-form ranks remain outside scope.

The tariff counts abstract unsigned symplectic transvections. Compatible signed Pauli corrections are free only under the cited projective tariff; absolute target phase needs an anchor. Native Gaussian rank, monomial passes, a profitable actual caller, dirty-owner restoration, routing, precision, stock, tape, compiler and complete signed supplier accounting remain unpriced. All five selected framework assumptions remain. No selected cold replay, native/compiler build, Lean or Docker run was performed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

The precommit refresh checked live open PRs and claims, source/author/card reservations, main object/formula/general-form README searches and merged PRs. The cached overlap refresh covers 435 open PRs and 6,414 Discussion records with complete remote pagination; its sparse local scan covers only 128 of 8,917 notes. Relevant source packages were materialized and main-tree searches supplemented that gap. Arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain limits.

## Open next questions

- Determine exact attainment for residual rank two at displacement rank at least three. Analyze what remains after an anisotropic pivot, including a nonzero alternating remainder.
- Supply one actual signed native contact, its fixed spectators and absolute phase anchor, then price every turn, correction, monomial pass and owner/restoration operation. A shorter formal word alone gives no recursive saving.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this exact higher-rank partial-map transvection minimum was found in the targeted live searches.

- #6443 optimizes unitary Clifford correction rank for a fixed reciprocal lane encoder. Its operator-rank objective and encoder contract differ from the prescribed partial-map turn count here. This result computes no shared correction-rank value and does not extend that model.

- #6489 counts unrestricted GL extensions of a prescribed partial injection under nested late capacities. This result instead minimizes binary symplectic transvection length for a rank-one residual form. No shared numerical quantity is computed.

The completion refresh inspected all eleven other open account PRs created since the CLAIM and added #6489 above. No inspected submission states a competing value for this exact partial-map turn minimum. No additional computations were run to audit another result.

The direct partial-contract predecessors #5051, #5085, #5097 and #5342 are merged; #5342 minimizes native Gaussian rank, which is a separate tariff.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/rank-one-residual-completion)`, passed at exact head `625a248021706eb91d76e89198cd31a4040a68f8` in [run 41556120987](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41556120987). The completed checks were read once: planning took 4m25s and registered replay took 1m19s. Separate run metadata confirms completed success at the matching commit. The registered replay executes both warning-strict normal and optimized scientific checks. Local registered/direct replay, committed-byte/source-history preflight and read-only Git-free export checks also passed. Hosted execution certifies the declared finite checks and source bindings; independent mathematical acceptance and formal proof-kernel verification remain unclaimed. No CI failure was observed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: research. Seven files are added in one isolated package; shared code, frozen sources and selected-frontier files are unchanged.
